name: Product carousel
description: A horizontally scrolling row of product cards, such as "You may also like" or "Recently viewed", with a heading, a view-all link, arrows and a counter.

fields.name: Heading
fields.helpText: Rendered as an h2, e.g. "You may also like".

fields.name: Collection
fields.helpText: Pick a collection. Overrides the handle below.

fields.name: Collection handle (legacy)
fields.helpText: Used when no collection is picked above. Picking one is preferred: it survives a renamed collection.

fields.name: View all label
fields.helpText: Makes the heading a link; read after the heading by assistive technology, e.g. "View all".

fields.name: View all link
fields.helpText: Where the heading links to. The collection variant links to the collection you picked instead.

fields.name: Section background
fields.helpText: none is the default (surface recommended for recently-viewed).
